newsitem.title: CANADA: Avenor shrholders defeat Repap deal.
newsitem.headline: Avenor shrholders defeat Repap deal.

text.p: Avenor Inc said shareholders voted 74 percent against a proposed merger with Repap Enterprises Inc at a special meeting of shareholders on Wednesday.
Avenor Chief Executive Paul Gagne told the special meeting he was disappointed that the merger agreement was not approved.
"We reget that the Repap transaction has been rejected," Gagne said.
Avenor had cut its stock and debt offer to one Avenor share for every eight Repap shares and excluded Repap's British Columbia operations from the deal.
Its original bid was one Avenor share for every 4.25 Repap shares, plus the assumption of C$2.4 billion in debt.
